note: KLHL20 is established as causing neurodevelopmental disorder with early-onset seizures and facial dysmorphism, and facial phenotyping has been applied in its delineation.

evidence.text: Doctoral work on next-generation sequencing and 3D facial phenotyping in medical genetics documented the identification of KLHL20 as a novel gene for a rare neurodevelopmental disorder presenting with intellectual disability, seizures, and facial dysmorphism.

source.title: MOLECULAR DIAGNOSTICS IN AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER: NEXT GENERATION SEQUENCING AND FACIAL PHENOTYPING IN MEDICAL GENETICS
